purpose: Classify the counter-indexed interaction animation root table and its contiguous frame/clear bank.

consumer.name: InteractionCounter_ConfigureActors
behavior: Divides PLAYER_INTERACTION_COUNTER by ten to obtain the quotient and uses the quotient as a longword index from 0x004A58.
Uses the remainder as a second longword index from the same table for the slot-7 actor.
Publishes the quotient root to the slot-6 actor when the quotient is nonzero and the remainder root to the slot-7 actor.

animation_bank.name: ACTOR_ANIM_INTERACTION_COUNTER_FRAME_BANK
animation_bank.entry_contract: Each entry is one frame reference word followed by EC 0x01, clearing the actor state after the selected counter frame.

boundary_basis: Exact longword table extent immediately before ROM_SCENE_TRANSITION_TABLE at 0x00004B04
Every selected nonzero root lands on a four-byte frame/EC01 entry in the bank
The bank is contiguous and ends immediately before ACTOR_ANIM_TYPE55_INTERACTION at 0x00122D54
